domains.canonicalOwner: Inventory movement ledger with transaction-scoped stock mutation
domains.rule: Operator stock-control mutations use AdvancedInventoryService; business transactions may mutate stock only inside their canonical transaction and must append InventoryMovement.
All sale, purchase and storefront-order return mutations enter through /returns/*; historical /sale-returns* and /purchase-returns* aliases are removed.
Business domains emit canonical AccountingEvent records; posting materializes balanced JournalEntry/JournalLine and no alternate public ledger mutation surface is authoritative.

domains.canonicalOwner: Commerce transaction payment lifecycle with PaymentsService as provider ingress adapter
domains.rule: Sale/order/finance transaction owners create or settle Payment; provider callbacks may only enter through PaymentsService and delegate to canonical commerce payment confirmation, never create a parallel payment ledger.

domains.canonicalOwner: Notification queue record plus asynchronous worker delivery lifecycle
domains.rule: API queues Notification records; worker owns delivery attempts/status. Platform replay/cancel controls operate on the same Notification record rather than a duplicate notification store.
Payroll configuration, calculation, approval, posting, adjustments and settlement use PayrollService; accounting output is linked to the canonical accounting ledger.
Asset acquisition, assignment, transfer, disposal, maintenance and depreciation are owned by AssetsService; financial impact links to canonical accounting records.
External marketplace orders are idempotently imported into MarketplaceOrder and linked to the canonical internal Order lifecycle; no second marketplace-order mutation API is authoritative.
Daily summaries are rebuildable aggregates. P3/P4 ownership remains ADMIN_EXPLICIT; they never replace Sale, AccountingEvent/JournalEntry, or InventoryMovement as transaction truth.
